content.narration: You are in Mercury Mahadasha (ends 2027-08-18, age ~43) -> Saturn Antardasha (ends 2027-08-18, age ~43) -> Moon Pratyantardasha (current, ends 2026-09-17, age ~42). Saturn, your Antardasha lord, is exalted in your 7 house (Vishakha). Moon, your Pratyantardasha lord, is neutral in your 11 house (Purva Bhadrapada).
